statusScope: Full funded-mainnet acceptance; local checks and narrower probes are separate

experiments.title: Harness, identities and evidence
steps: Pin code revision, chain genesis, exact programs/configuration, costs, disposable asset names and wallet roles.
Reserve independent wallets for payer, treasury, Alice, Bob and negative tests; separate account rent, fees and locked capital.
Use the local runner's typed builders, inspect exact instruction/account effects, and retain simulation, signature, final receipt and postcondition evidence.
passCriteria: Every action has expected account deltas, cost ceiling and replay identity.
No keys or funded addresses enter the public Git history.
experiments.blocker: Runner implemented and locally tested. Actual mainnet execution awaits a funded browser wallet and per-transaction approval; full POC acceptance remains open.

experiments.title: Disposable original token
steps: Choose provisional SPL/Token-2022 settings only after protocol compatibility checks; no official $10X chain/allocation decision is inferred.
Create a disposable mint, set metadata/supply/authorities and test transfer plus real buy/sell route if affordable.
passCriteria: Supply and allocations reconcile; unsupported extensions rejected.
Retained authorities are explicit; buy and sell complete with expected balances.
experiments.blocker: Original launch mechanism and allocation remain provisional.

experiments.title: Attention/original pool and fees
steps: Create a Meteora DAMM v2 test ATT/original pool using the intended 80% allocation, actual activation and quote-token fee configuration.
Check pre-activation rejection, schedule boundaries through the first 90 seconds, both swap directions, output limits, permanent LP lock and fee collection.
Compare each fresh quote with execution using retained pre-swap state; separate protocol fees from total trading fees.
passCriteria: Pool identities and balance deltas match configuration.
Locked liquidity cannot be withdrawn; permitted fees remain collectable.
No one-unit seed is represented as realistic market economics.
experiments.blocker: Current program/configuration and complete setup cost must be verified.

experiments.title: Complete allocation and two campaigns
steps: Fund exactly 80/10/5/2.5/2.5 into liquidity/Earn/Stake/permanent/seasonal destinations.
Run no-active-Season fallback and active-Season cases; keep historical fallback allocations fixed.
Interrupt setup and replay without double-funding; reserve all unminted entitlements.
passCriteria: All supply reconciles in base units.
Partial setup cannot activate an integrated campaign; overlapping campaigns remain separate.
experiments.blocker: Depends on enforceable custody from P04/P06 for a complete campaign. Isolated pool P02 is only a protocol experiment.

experiments.title: Stake custody and lifecycle
steps: Reproduce the known administrator-principal-withdrawal counterexample locally; evaluate a reviewed restricted configuration or alternative.
Test same-token deposit/reward, late entry, empty periods, fractional rates, repeated harvest, immediate withdrawal/re-stake, ten-day end and surplus recovery.
Challenge direct program instructions, not merely API permissions.
passCriteria: Principal and earned rewards survive all allowed admin operations.
Empty periods do not create catch-up rewards; rounding and unused balances reconcile.
experiments.blocker: Known unrestricted Kamino admin can withdraw deposited principal; selected fee/configuration, precision and license review remain open.

experiments.title: Earn evidence, final awards and claims
steps: Use real supported Farcaster/X posts with complete authorized capture and authorship evidence; score and settle a small board.
Verify thresholds, per-wallet caps, cutoff completeness, immutable results, first-launch empty-board 1% burn and pending-vs-empty distinction.
Use actual distributor proof format; test cliff/linear vesting, partial claims, duplicates and independent proof recovery.
passCriteria: Awards equal funded liabilities; incomplete feeds never produce an empty-board burn.
Partial/late claims remain available; duplicate claims rejected.
experiments.blocker: X excerpt is insufficient full evidence; funding/timing configuration and distributor review unresolved.

experiments.title: Permanent NFT custody and transferable claims
steps: Model all 10,000 reserve positions locally and mint only a costed small on-chain sample.
Fund before mint, bind slots fairly, inherit historical vesting; Alice claims part, transfers, Bob claims rest; reject former owner.
Check account delegates, external burns, collection plugins, image-update permissions and portable proofs.
passCriteria: No double claim, vesting restart, reserve reassignment or unintended loss of historical rights.
Economic attributes remain protected while supported image changes work.
experiments.blocker: Known Core burn/authority policy conflicts; ordinary burns can strand signer funds.

experiments.title: Paid mint, assignment and reveal
steps: Test finite shared inventory, eligible stages, paid/free/founder categories and concurrent last-slot requests.
Bind payment to future randomness; test timeout, retry, refund and failed fulfillment without free redraw.
Test provisional USD-denominated Season 0 payment quote separately from historical SOL stages; use simple locally served metadata or an approved storage path.
passCriteria: No overselling, duplicate charge, privileged assignment or outcome-dependent redraw.
Accepted payments reach the defined asset/refund result; metadata is retrievable.
experiments.blocker: Randomness/provider and fee quotes not selected; hosted metadata may require separate provisioning.

experiments.title: Card progression and expiry
steps: Upgrade two same-Season equal-Level Cards; target rises one Level, material redraws without burn.
Test execution-time owner/Level checks, atomicity or reviewed escrow, retries and concurrent transfers.
Exercise reroll fees/cooldowns across transfers, month-end expiry, reactivation and historical claims.
passCriteria: No half-updated pair, repeated fee or cooldown reset.
Expiry affects future eligibility only; prior allocations remain unchanged.
experiments.blocker: Requires on-chain metadata/authority configuration compatible with P06 and real randomness.

experiments.title: Wallet and marketplace compatibility
steps: On actual selected desktop/mobile wallets, verify transaction decoding, signing return and unsupported-message behaviour.
Test direct transfer, listing, cancellation, purchase, escrow ownership, metadata refresh and remaining-claim disclosure.
Measure realized royalties rather than assuming enforcement.
passCriteria: The actual current claimant matches on-chain ownership through each supported custody state.
Wallet/device evidence is recorded separately from browser fixtures.
experiments.blocker: Requires physical wallet/user participation and a supported marketplace. Do not imply market demand from self-trades.

experiments.title: Recovery, outages and integration rehearsal
steps: Run one complete campaign with distinct disposable test assets; include P07-P09 only if offering those features.
Test RPC timeout, expired unsigned packet, ambiguous submission, service restart, replay, restore, stale observations and independently retained proofs.
Reconcile after finality; pause optional new actions while preserving claims/withdrawals.
Run accelerated time locally, then complete real 24/48-hour and ten-day observations; no shortened experiment counts as full duration.
passCriteria: Zero unexplained base-unit variance; recovery creates no duplicate financial action.
Results distinguish local/simulator/read-only-mainnet/funded-mainnet evidence.
Every offered feature has compatible custody and a measured cost.
experiments.blocker: Full-duration mainnet validation cannot finish overnight; no financial transactions will be signed by this agent.
